w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Buffering, The Paparazzo, The Ugly Bastard, Big-Bane) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "The audience is bored of the rerun. Do something they haven’t seen."
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "That's not an honor. It's just what the aliens like to see. You're going on television."
📺 SYSTEM: "Make it beautiful or make it tragic. Ideally both. — C. Sable"
📺 SYSTEM: "The audience is bored of the rerun. Do something they haven’t seen."
📺 SYSTEM: "● LIVE — The Mystery Smell. YOU is on television."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The System's messages have gotten careful around you. It chooses its words the way you choose footing on ice.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: Calorie Run. One hour. Whoever collects the most calorie-dense materials wins. The forest is... competitive."

noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
